Pargiter’s critical edition of the Purāṇic lists of the dynasties of the Kali age (Magadha, the Śiśunāgas, Nandas, Mauryas, Śuṅgas, Āndhras and others) with introduction and notes (Oxford, 1913). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Purana Text Of The Dynasties Of The Kali Age · Pargiter, F. E. Ed. · 1913, 138 scanned pages. Published 1913; Frederick Eden Pargiter died 1927; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
